items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier and Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-01-18
items.q: You know, I've never been to know Happy Bolton.

ctx.x: I think that's his name is Bolton.

Say, when you'll be playing a reg, say like, you know, Joplin's Sensation? Sensation? Sensation? I don't know. You remember the climax rag, George Lewis? Lyrite Theatre, you know the climax? How would you break them? How would you break them? Sensation. Sensation. You haven't played that here for many years, honey. Which one? Well, what's a rag builder rocking? Sensation. I don't know. You remember Climax rag, George Lewis.
